title: Chapter 951
text:
The spaceships along the way all moved to the side, making a path for the Black Star fleet to pass through.

Under the excited and expectant gazes of countless people, the Black Star fleet slowly flew above the Black Star Tyrant. The black steel hatch opened, and countless mechanical soldiers swarmed out, forming a long dragon. They quickly formed a dense and neat formation in the sky, occupying the sky. Their armor reflected the same galaxy.

Pairs of mechanical eyes looked down at the brown planet below, focusing on the lonely Tyrant.

Heber stood with his hands behind his back, unmoved. He coldly looked at the dense mechanical army in the sky and suddenly snorted. His powerful lungs let out a roaring sound wave.

Buzz!

The echo was like thunder. Then, every cell of Heber's began to pump energy crazily, allowing the radars of every spaceship to detect a high-energy reaction. The Pugilist flames in his body roared and surged, condensing on his legs. His body seemed to have become countless times heavier. Even though he was standing still, the ground under his feet cracked and spread.

Both sides had assumed battle stances and were itching to fight. The tense and austere atmosphere was like an invisible net that instantly enveloped the entire battlefield.

Countless people present became nervous and could not help but hold their breaths.

This time, the Lord's Avatar stepped out from the crowd and came to the front of the Mech Legion. Its body was covered in Mechanical Force, and its eyes were shining. It carried Han Xiao's will.

"I'm here," Han Xiao said in the public channel.

"Humph."

Heber snorted coldly.

This time, the dynasty did not interfere. Both of them knew that the battle would only end when one of them fell.

Suddenly, Heber bent his knees and stomped on the ground. With him as the center, a shockwave spread out in all directions.

Boom!

The ground cracked under his feet, and Heber shot into the sky like a rocket. His eyes flashed with a cold fighting spirit, and he shot toward the Mech Legion in the sky like a golden meteor!

In the sky, violent Mechanical Force surged out from the Lord's Avatar, instantly connecting all the Mech Legion. At this moment, Han Xiao activated many skills and habitually cast a [Luck Curse] on Heber.

The next moment, the vanguard troops, who were in charge of attacking and resisting, suddenly dove down and charged toward Heber.

There was no point in saying anything in such a situation. There was no foreplay. Both sides went straight to the point as soon as they met.

The golden meteor collided with the vanguard mechanical army. Countless melted armor and broken parts exploded like bombs, shooting everywhere!

Bang! Bang! Bang!

Heavy mechanical soldiers shattered and fell one after another. The golden meteor penetrated deep into the formation before gradually slowing down and being entangled by countless machines.

The long-range troops at the back spread out and spun around Heber like a metal tornado. They shot out psionic cannons and dark energy annihilation cannons one after another. Countless beams of light shot toward Heber from all directions without any blind spots.

The black mechanical army surrounded Heber, and this scene was like a flock of crows dancing around the sun. From time to time, reddish-gold martial arts waves would shoot out from the center, piercing through the flock of crows' formation like shooting out sunflames.

A dazzling reddish-gold beam of light shot out, and the dozens of mechanical soldiers jointly activated their psionic shields. The beam of light exploded on the blue shields, creating an expanding energy shockwave. The huge explosion blasted these mechanical soldiers away, but they were not destroyed in one hit. After flying for a distance, they regained control of their bodies and turned around to continue the battle.

Han Xiao's Mech Legion had been strengthened many times. Even when facing a Beyond Grade A, they would not be so weak. Although this batch of old machines had not been upgraded into the products of a Divine Throne Mechanic, under the enhancement of his Mechanical Force, they were no longer mechanical soldiers that Heber could casually destroy.

In this battle, the situation Heber faced was different from before.

In the previous battle, Heber's goal was to establish his dominance and eliminate Han Xiao's main body as quickly as possible.

However, now that Black Star had risen to fame, Heber did not need to end the battle as quickly as possible. He was very clear that since Han Xiao's main body was not here, the only way to win this battle was to eliminate all the Mech Legion present.

Once he destroyed all the troops brought by Black Star's doppelganger, he would win!

Therefore, Heber's mentality became stable and was not anxious at all. He had long been prepared for a protracted battle. He focused on killing the mechanical soldiers and charged brazenly between the formations. He did not have any intention of charging head-on at all.

The protective aura around his body turned into a golden ball of light, enveloping Heber within. From time to time, psionic cannons would hit Heber's body, but most of the damage was reduced by his protective aura and various resistance talents.

However, the remaining damage still made Heber feel even more pressured than before. When the psionic cannon hit his body, every attack that passed through his protective energy and hit his body caused him to feel pain.

Heber was secretly shocked by Han Xiao's growth speed. He clenched his teeth and thought to himself.

Although I can only fight a protracted battle, the longer it drags on, the more disadvantageous it will be for me. I have to increase my killing efficiency.

With this thought, he could not help but increase the frequency and strength of his attacks.

On the other side, Han Xiao controlled the Lord's Avatar to observe the battle and frowned as he looked at the combat information on the interface.

"What a tough and thick super HP bull."

During the previous battle, there were still many question marks on Heber's combat information interface. Now that his level was higher than Heber's, the information he received was complete.

Heber's level was 296, and some of it was the level of his subclass. Han Xiao was an anomaly. Compared to him, the level difference did not have much reference value.

Although his overall level was not much different from Han Xiao's, Heber's Grade was still S and did not have a '+'. This was the difference brought about by various bonuses.

Heber's HP was around 8,000,000, and his Endurance was over 12,000. He also had a bunch of Explosive Skills that increased his Strength, Agility, and Endurance. Needless to say, he also had all sorts of Pugilist Skills.

He had a lot of resistance talents, such as True Damage Immunity, Low Damage Immunity, Fixed Damage Reduction, Super Toughness, and so on. These were all talents that Han Xiao had seen in the previous battle, and their defense was terrifyingly high.

Due to the interference of the dynasty, the previous battle ended with the Tyrant retreating, and there was no clear victor between the two of them. Han Xiao obtained a tie, but in reality, he did not deal much damage to Heber back then.

Against Heber, he could only slowly grind away at his HP. Luckily, his Mechanical Force bonuses and the Mech Legion had been strengthened many times, so his damage was significantly higher.

Therefore, Han Xiao did not use the [Perfect Mechanical Sense] Character Summon Card this time, nor did he need to.

Under normal circumstances, the Tyrant was no longer his opponent!

After the battle began, a Grade S mission popped up on his interface, named ['Tyrant' Heber]. It was exactly the same as the mission triggered in the previous battle. According to the different circumstances of challenging a Beyond Grade A Super, such a mission would be randomly generated, and it was triggered this time as well.

"This avatar of mine only carries a portion of my attributes and abilities, but it's enough to fight Heber head-on and reduce the speed at which he kills the Mech Legion."

With a thought, Han Xiaoxin's Lord's Avatar suddenly attacked, passing through the many layers of defense and heading straight for Heber, who was in the center. A metal fist covered in Mechanical Force and Psionic Energy punched out.

With a cold snort, Heber's muscles bulged, and it was as if there were many entangled pythons hidden under his skin. His tendons stretched, and his fresh muscle fibers twisted into a bundle, twisting out a powerful elastic force. A terrifying force gathered from his entire body to his arm, and he turned around to punch the Lord's Avatar.

The crimson gold fist collided with the blue metallic fist, and an intense energy shockwave burst forth, quickly spreading in all directions!

Dong!

The intense shockwave pushed the surrounding mechanical soldiers a long distance away, and an empty space was created in the atmosphere above Black Star.

With the bonuses of [Heroic Wrists], [Divine Void Force], and other growth talents, Han Xiao's current Strength had reached more than six thousand points, and his melee attack was also very impressive.

The battle between the two moved around Black Star, and the galactic residents watching from afar closely followed the battle.

On one of the spaceships, the Radiant Federation's scouts were recording the battle.

Radiance and Ethereal placed great importance on this battle, and they had both sent out scouts to collect information.

Black Star's current strength would affect their plans for the Evolution Cube, so they had no choice but to pay attention to it.

At this moment, Manison's remote projection was standing in a corner of the cabin, watching the battle through the window.

"The Tyrant's chances of winning are very slim."

"Is that so? I feel that although the Tyrant is surrounded, his body is very tough. He should be able to last until the Mech Legion is completely wiped out," the captain carefully expressed his opinion.

Manison shook his head. "I can feel that Black Star is stronger than before, and Heber won't be able to last that long. His condition will only get worse … Furthermore, Black Star still has many trump cards that he hasn't used yet, such as the Void ability on Planet Lighthouse."

Hearing this, the captain nodded in agreement.

"I just don't know …" After a pause, Manison pondered. "How much has Black Star grown? Could it be that he's already at my level? It can't be that fast, right? "

At this moment, the space in the distance suddenly fluctuated, and the magnificent Palace of Hidden Spells jumped over.

"Oh, they've already started fighting. Looks like I'm late."

At the top of the Palace of Hidden Spells, Austin sat cross-legged in mid-air, watching the battle between the two with an interested expression on his small face.

At this moment, most people's attention was on the battle between Han Xiao and the Tyrant. Although they noticed Austin's arrival, they only glanced at him briefly before eagerly turning their gazes back to the battle.

Han Xiao also noticed Austin and could not help but twitch his mouth.

Why are you always the referee when we fight?

You're Captain Dragonfly?

However, he did not have the time to care about the old man. Han Xiao retracted his attention and continued to control the Lord's Avatar to fight Heber head-on.

Boom boom boom!

Black Star's surface rapidly became riddled with holes. The aftershocks of the battle and the missed psionic cannons would occasionally land on the ground, creating countless craters.

As the battle progressed, Black Star's surface shattered and became filled with craters, as if it had turned into an onion. The crust of the planet was shaved off layer by layer, and the shape of the entire planet changed. The battle between Han Xiao and the Tyrant was like a carving knife, carving this planet with broad strokes.

Facing the human wave tactic alone, and the damage of the Mech Legion was beyond imagination, Heber quickly fell into a disadvantage and became very passive. Everyone in Bloodshed Land felt their hearts clench.

Facing a team, His Excellency Tyrant is already so passive. Furthermore, he fell into a disadvantage not long after the battle began … Could it be that the difference between the two of them is even greater than we thought?

In the previous battle, His Excellency Tyrant was clearly suppressing Black Star. In just a few years, the positions had swapped. Every dog has its day …

Looking at the Tyrant, who was in a rather sorry state, Fosters clenched his fists tightly, his expression uncertain.

…

Boom boom boom!

A series of psionic cannons landed on Heber's back, and the power penetrated his body. A metallic taste appeared in Heber's throat, and his body paused for a moment. Just as he revealed an opening, Han Xiao's Lord's Avatar seized the opportunity and punched him in the chest. Then, both of his hands turned into a giant cannon, shooting out a dazzling blue beam and sending him flying.

Halfway through the flight, just as Heber was about to stabilize himself, the psionic cannons focused fire came again, blasting him into the air.

Suddenly, a huge impact came from his back, and a large group of melee mechanical soldiers waving all kinds of ferocious weapons slammed into his back, changing his trajectory once again.

After being continuously attacked like a storm for so long, no matter how strong Heber's body was, he could not take it anymore. He felt like he was a sandbag being crazily beaten up. His entire body was in pain, and he had fewer and fewer opportunities to fight back.

Bang!

After being beaten up for a few rounds, Heber fell straight to the ground, creating a human-shaped crater!

"Cough … Star Shaking Fist!"

Enduring the excruciating pain, Heber hastily mustered up his strength and blasted out a thick, dazzling golden Pugilist wave toward the mechanical army that was chasing after him in the sky. A gigantic chain reaction explosion ball of light exploded, and the light devoured a large number of mechanical soldiers.

However, after the energy dissipated, he discovered that most of the mechanical soldiers had used psionic shields to block it. Although they were heavily injured, they could still continue to fight and could not even be forced to use [Waste Modification].

"The difference … How is it so huge?"

Heber was shocked and angry. When he accepted the challenge, he was still quite confident, thinking that he should have a high chance of winning against Black Star's team.

However, after fighting for so long, he had already used all his means, but in the end, he discovered that he might not even be able to defeat Black Star's team!

How is this possible!

In the beginning, Heber could still resist the encirclement of the Mech Legion when he was at his peak state. However, as his injuries worsened and his energy consumption increased, his condition inevitably deteriorated.

Han Xiao was different. He was the type of person who fought more and more bravely. Just the circulation of his HP and MP alone ensured that his energy would remain high. He also had talents like [Advanced Strengthened Life], [Battlefield Wisdom], and [One Against 10,000 Men] that increased his attributes along with the battle. The longer he fought, the higher his combat power would be. Under such circumstances, Heber was becoming more and more pathetic, almost becoming the king of beatings.

If this continues, I'm definitely going to lose!

Thinking of this, Heber's eyes suddenly turned blood red. He did not like any form of failure, especially losing to Black Star in such a pathetic manner. This was the most unacceptable to him.

Boom!

The next moment, Heber's entire body blazed, and the high-energy reaction he emitted continued to soar in an abnormal manner. The pugilist wave that gushed out tore all the mechanical soldiers nearby into pieces of metal.

"Oh, what skill did he use?"

Han Xiaoxin looked at the interface and realized that a new status had appeared on Heber's status bar — [Polar Channel Flow — Cellular Overdrive].

He was not unfamiliar with this move. This was a pugilist skill that players had learned in his previous life. Its effect was to forcefully activate the potential of the cells, overclocking the body, energy, and other attributes to the greatest extent, temporarily obtaining the combat power for the next Promotion within a few hours to a few days.

However, the repercussions were very serious. Once this skill was used, the cost of leveling up one's character and skill would permanently increase by 7%! Every time it was used, it would stack once. There was no upper limit!

It was equivalent to squeezing out one's future potential in exchange for temporary explosive power!

Normally, no one would use this move unless they had no other choice.

Han Xiao was a little stunned. "Is it really that hard to accept losing to me? You even resorted to such a self-destructive move … "

However, the next moment, when he saw Heber's eyes, Han Xiao understood.

That pair of bloodshot eyes were filled with the stubbornness and pride of an expert.

Although the Tyrant's usual style was very pretentious, at this moment, Han Xiao had to admit that this was a qualified warrior.

"Indeed, those who can become Beyond Grade As are a bunch of people who don't easily admit defeat." Han Xiao pursed his lips.

The sudden burst of energy from Heber was also sensed by the radars of everyone present. They were all shocked and began discussing in the public channel.

"Woah, the Tyrant's high-energy reaction is still rising!"

"What's going on? Is Heber going to use his trump card?"

"I thought he was done for, but it seems like there's still a chance!"

"Is the Tyrant going to turn the situation around?"

Heber's body was covered in flames, and he directly crossed the 52,000 Energy Rank limit. His Grade also rose to S +, and the wounds on his body were rapidly healing.

He stared at Han Xiao with anger. He clenched his fists, and a dazzling golden light lit up in his palms, becoming brighter and brighter. It looked like he was preparing for a big move.

At this moment, Han Xiao's Lord's Avatar suddenly stopped in midair and looked down at Heber, whose aura was rising crazily.

"Since you're so serious, I won't play with you anymore."

As soon as he said that, Mechanical Force spread out like a spider web and connected to every single mechanical soldier.

The next moment, all the mechanical soldiers flew toward the Lord's Avatar like birds returning to their nests. They assembled and stuck together, and a huge mechanical construct gradually took shape.

The Mechanical Force chains that connected every single one of them were like the nerves, blood vessels, and tendons of a huge lifeform!

Buzz buzz buzz!

The mechanical soldiers seemed to have turned into parts one after another, and all the scattered mechanical soldiers quickly merged into one.

"This … this is …"

Under the shocked gazes of countless people, a huge mechanical assembly appeared in the sky above the Black Tyrant Star, its size extremely shocking.

A heavy wave spread out from this huge mechanical assembly, and everyone had an intuition that this was not simply piecing together all the machines. This assembly … was an independent new entity!

Heber's eyes widened, and the Pugilist wave that he was rubbing started to flicker like a light bulb.

At the same time, Manison, who was watching the battle from the Radiant Federation's spaceship, seemed to have been smashed by a huge hammer. His eyes widened, and shock flashed through them.

"This is … a Mechanical Deity?"

—
